mon.style: Official Academy reference — clean outlined 2D educational illustration
mon.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer, new illustrated scene using the attached official-school reference images.
Asset type: landscape student portal login illustration, 3:2 composition, no text.
Input images: both images are STRICT STYLE REFERENCES, not photos. Match their exact clean 2D educational cartoon look: precise dark contours, expressive believable young-adult faces, simplified drawn eyes/noses, flat bright cel shading, clean layered foliage, inviting luminous modern learning spaces. Keep it unmistakably hand-drawn digital illustration. Do not make it a realistic painting.
Scene: MONDAY — a smiling young adult BTS student, about 20 years old, with dark wavy hair, in a cream sweatshirt, seated at a light wood study desk and writing a plan in an open notebook with a pen. One closed laptop and a small plant beside the notebook. Bright modern campus library with large windows, shelves, trees outside, sunny daytime.
Composition: medium-wide illustrated scene filling the frame, student face and hands prominent, person placed slightly left of center, natural anatomically clear hands and notebook interaction, clean scene with room around the face.
Colors: lively but refined olive green, teal accents, warm sand, cream, light wood, sunlit warm skin tones. The original references' dark royal-blue furniture must become olive/teal; no large dark-blue or pink areas.
Constraints: absolutely no photorealism, oil painting, watercolor, textured brush painting, 3D render, stock photo, exaggerated anime, tiny child or elderly person. No logos, no lettering, no readable text, no border, no watermark. Preserve the reference's cheerful crisp 2D outlined illustration style above all.
